# Indy

> Indy is an all-in-one CRM and business management platform designed to empower freelancers and independent professionals with tools for proposals, invoicing, time tracking, client management, and project collaboration.

Indy provides a comprehensive suite of integrated tools that help freelancers streamline their business operations, from initial client proposals through project delivery and payment processing. The platform serves diverse professional niches including designers, writers, videographers, virtual assistants, and business coaches.

## Key Topics

- Freelancer Tools

## Financial Management Tools

- [Invoicing Software for Freelancers: Create Pro Invoices with Indy](https://weareindy.com/tools/invoices): Indy invoice generator with time tracker sync and recurring invoice capabilities
- [Proposal Software for Freelancers: Create Business Proposals with Indy](https://weareindy.com/tools/proposals): Indy proposal software with templates for creating professional business proposals
- [Time Tracker: manage your hours worked and bill your clients](https://weareindy.com/tools/time-tracker): Indy time tracker for billing, custom rates, and client reporting
- [Contract Maker: Create Contracts Online with Indy](https://weareindy.com/tools/contracts): Contract Maker tool with ready-made templates and digital signature capabilities

## Project & Collaboration Tools

- [Project Portal: Your CRM for Freelancers](https://weareindy.com/tools/project-portal): Project Portal shared workspace for client collaboration and project management
- [Task Management Software for Freelancers: Get your job done!](https://weareindy.com/tools/tasks): Indy task management software with calendar integration and time tracker
- [Indy's Calendar Planner: Sync Tasks, Meetings, & Projects](https://weareindy.com/tools/calendar): Indy calendar planner syncing tasks, meetings, deadlines with Google Calendar
- [Project Review, Proofing, and Approval Tool | Indy Files](https://weareindy.com/tools/files): Indy Files tool for client file sharing, proofing, revisions, and approvals

## Client Engagement Tools
